data.content_ref: inline:INTEGRATION: The isolated problem's resolution integrates SRC_001's barrier, SRC_002's consumer-projection quarantine, and SRC_005's side-channel analysis into a complete resumption decision procedure: resumption is safe iff (barrier present at truncation point) OR (no consumer read the partial fragment AND no side-channel state leaked AND the causal fingerprint of the last complete event matches the continuation). This integration is non-trivial because each condition addresses a different layer: SRC_001 addresses logical-unit boundaries, SRC_002 addresses downstream state, SRC_005 addresses the computation's internal channels. The three conditions are disjunctive in the barrier (barrier subsumes the others) but conjunctive in its absence. REFUTED IF: a barrier event is shown to be insufficient for safety—e.g., a barrier marks the continuation point but a consumer still read the partial fragment before the barrier was emitted—making the disjunction invalid and requiring the conjunction to hold even with barriers present.
